item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.31 (49)
- In the Review panel, "Before:" and "After:" now show the whole text, not two lines. The panel opens wider and grows taller for a long dictation, and only what the screen can't hold scrolls. - The floating recording panel shows the whole text before and after GPT-6 Luna's review too. - "After:" keeps its room only while GPT-6 Luna is checking, so "No change" leaves no blank space. - A correct fix from GPT-6 Luna that changes most of a short sentence now goes in by default instead of waiting as a suggestion. A change to a negation, a number, code or a Dictionary word still waits.
